findings.description: Changed `match.match` to `match.fullmatch`, so the regex must now match the entire exception string rather than just a prefix. This changes the semantics of the `match` argument.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `match="timeout"` with exception text "timeout after 5s". Before, `re.match` succeeded and the retry happened. Now `fullmatch` fails, so the retry is silently skipped or the exception is raised. Existing users relying on prefix matching (the documented behavior of re.match) break.
